image_description: A close-up view of a pipe organ console and the lower section of its pipe facade. The image features multiple wooden manuals (keyboards) with black and white keys, stop tabs arranged vertically on the sides, and a music rack holding sheet music. Behind the console, vertical metallic pipes of varying lengths are visible within a wooden casing.
